subject: prd/init-hardening
statement: If any stage fails after mutation begins, then the system shall restore the target to its pre-run state — removing exactly the writes it performed and the repository it created, where it created one, preserving any foreign entry that appeared during the run and naming it in the report — and report the failed stage with its remedy.
rationale: as-found or fully-installed, nothing between (`#D-5`, closing `#F-8`); restore must never delete what init did not write
fit_criterion: per-stage failure injection leaves the target byte-identical to pre-run (created-repo case: the folder returns to empty); a foreign file planted mid-apply survives the rollback and is named; a subsequent init proceeds past admission
